ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the cube figure above, only the front square face has two diagonals drawn, forming an X, indicating that this face is cut along the two diagonals; the other visible faces are still complete squares. Below there are five nets numbered 1 to 5. Observing one by one: No. 1 has 5 squares and 4 triangles; No. 2 has 5 squares and 4 triangles; No. 3 has 6 squares and 4 triangles; No. 4 has 5 squares and 4 triangles; No. 5 has 5 squares and 5 triangles. Reasoning: A cube has a total of 6 square faces, of which one face is cut by two diagonals into 4 triangles, so the net should contain exactly 5 complete squares and 4 triangles. The quantities of 1, 2, and 4 fit; 3 has one extra complete square; 5 has one extra triangle. Therefore, the two impossible nets are 3 and 5.

raw_record.question_text: One face of the cube is cut along its diagonals, as shown in the figure. Which two numbered nets are impossible?

method.method_draft: Use a face-inventory count. From the cube image, read that exactly one square face has been cut along both diagonals, so that face becomes 4 triangular pieces, while the other 5 cube faces remain full squares. Then inspect each numbered net in the lower image and count its pieces. Nets 1, 2, and 4 each have 5 squares and 4 triangles. Net 3 has 6 square faces plus 4 triangles, which is too many square faces for a cube with one face subdivided. Net 5 has 5 squares but 5 triangles, whereas the cut face should contribute only 4 triangles. Therefore the impossible nets are 3 and 5.

method.method_draft: Use a folding-boundary model. Treat the uncut square faces in a valid net as a 5-square skeleton of the cube, leaving one missing square face whose boundary is made of four edges. The four triangular pieces from the cut face must attach to exactly those four boundary edges and fold together to fill the missing face. Inspecting the nets: in net 3, the square skeleton already contains 6 squares, so it would fold as a complete ordinary cube and leaves no missing square face for the four triangular pieces. In net 5, the square skeleton has 5 squares, but there are five triangular attachments; after four fill the boundary of the single cut face, the extra triangle has no corresponding cube edge and would overlap or protrude. Thus nets 3 and 5 cannot be folded into the given cut cube.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：上方图示是一个立方体，其中前面这个正方形面被两条对角线切开，形成四个三角形部分。下方给出编号1到5的五个展开图，每个展开图由若干完整正方形和若干三角形附片组成。观察可见：1号有5个正方形和4个三角形；2号有5个正方形和4个三角形；3号有6个正方形并带有4个三角形；4号有5个正方形和4个三角形；5号有5个正方形但带有5个三角形。推理：采用折叠边界模型。因为立方体共有6个面，其中一个面被沿对角线切成4个三角形，所以展开图中未切开的面应形成5个正方形的骨架，剩下的一个缺失正方形面的四条边正好由4个三角形折回去填补。3号的正方形骨架已经有6个完整正方形，会折成一个普通完整立方体，已经没有缺失的正方形面可供4个三角形填补，因此不可能。5号虽然有5个正方形骨架，但图中有5个三角形；缺失的切开面只需要4个三角形，多出的一个三角形没有对应的立方体边，会重叠或突出，因此也不可能。因此不可能的两个展开图是3和5。
